Roughly 45 consecutive apply_patch edits implementing the whole surface with NO test runs between components — an undifferentiated implementation push rather than milestones each closed by a check.
Verification (compile checks then first full test run) only begins after nearly all implementation is done; tests were deferred to the end rather than gating per-component milestones.
Later some targeted focus (analysis_tests alone at 143, then full workspace run at 169), but this is debug-driven, not a pre-planned milestone completion signal per component.

reasoning: The agent showed real dependency awareness in the order it explored and (implicitly) built the modules — foundational model/io before layout/alignment/cli — which lifts it above the vague 'just implement and pass tests' anchor (3). But it did not group work into milestones each ending with a runnable test: implementation was one large monolithic batch (steps 41-89) with verification deferred to a single push at the end (90-102), so it falls short of the level-5 description of tackling components in dependency order with each grouping closed by a test. That places observed behavior at 4.
